options.name: Hunger
options.benefit: Magical nourishment provides no benefit. Gain a secondary bite and start combat sickened until your bite deals damage. At curse level 5 the bite gains grab against smaller foes, at 10 its damage increases by one size category, and at 15 it can drain 1d2 Constitution while grappling.

options.name: Powerless Prophecy
options.benefit: Gain uncanny dodge. In a surprise round, you may only use Flash of Insight. Without a surprise round, you are staggered in round one. At curse levels 5 and 10, gain +4 insight to initiative and improved uncanny dodge respectively. At curse level 15, gain +4 insight to AC and saves during surprise rounds and against attacks you are unaware of.
